lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: This is Quiry.
I see you have no problems typing.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: None at all!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Administrative work is my specialty, after all.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I excel at all things paperwork.
So you can read the letters just fine?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Not exactly.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I know the keyboard layout by heart, so I can touch type.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: It's not like the keys are gonna run off, right?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Anyway, I can make them out as long as I squint hard enough.
That's bad for your eyes.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I do it all day long,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: so I'm used to it by now.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: As compared to these,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'm more worried about whether I can adapt well here.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Thanks to my poor eyesight, even navigating around is a challenge.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: While on the Ark, I relied on memorizing the routes I frequently took,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: so I can't imagine how many things I'm gonna end up breaking in the Outpost TT^TT

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: So I'd like to apologize in advance.
What does having poor eyesight have to do with breaking things?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Well, for example,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'd mistake a protruding brick for a doorknob to yank

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: and cause the entire building to collapse,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: or I'd confused the TV with a window

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: and it's safe to say that the TV won't be working anymore.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Things like that

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: tend to happen all the time. Hehe.
Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Yep yep. Hehe.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: So don't worry too much about it.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Poli and Miranda said that they would try their best to help me.
I'll help too.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: That's very kind of you!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Poli is calling me, so I've got to go.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'll do my best to get used to the Outpost ASAP.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Thank you in advance.
You're welcome.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: See ya!
